name: zotero-mcp
description: Connect Claude Code to Zotero through the official Local API.

zotero_backend.title: Zotero backend
zotero_backend.description: Use local for Zotero 10+ Local API or web for zotero.org.

zotero_local_library_prefix.title: Zotero local library prefix
zotero_local_library_prefix.description: Use /users/0 for the current personal library.

zotero_api_key.title: Zotero Web API key
zotero_api_key.description: Optional Zotero Web API key when zotero_backend is web.

zotero_user_id.title: Zotero user ID
zotero_user_id.description: Optional Zotero user id for Web API workflows.

zotero_group_id.title: Zotero group ID
zotero_group_id.description: Optional Zotero group id for Web API workflows.

crossref_email.title: Crossref email
crossref_email.description: Optional real contact email used for CrossRef and Unpaywall requests.
